description: Broken links and meta tag check for one public page. Reports title, meta description and its length, html lang, viewport, canonical, h1 count, og:title, and og:description, then checks up to 50 links on that page. authorized is true. No further pages are crawled. Price 0.05 USD in USDC on Base, settled after a successful check.

authorized.description: True when the caller may scan this URL.

name: check_links_meta
